tagline: Your AI Health Companion — Speaks Your Language, Understands Your Needs
hero_desc: Democratizing medical triage for 900M+ rural & underserved individuals. Powered by Google Gemini 2.0, voice-first STT/TTS in 10+ languages, offline PWA, pill vision AI, and emergency GPS SOS.
problem_subtitle: Why MediMitra AI is a game-changer for India's 900M+ underserved population.
prob_1_desc: India faces a 1:10,000 doctor-to-patient ratio in rural districts. MediMitra AI provides instant 24/7 preliminary triage.
prob_2_desc: Most health apps require English reading skills. MediMitra AI listens and speaks natively in Hindi, Kannada, Tamil, Telugu, and English.
prob_3_desc: Built as a PWA with local indexed storage and cached triage logic, enabling full usage in remote zero-network zones.
suite_title: 5 Powerful AI Modules in One Platform
suite_symptom_desc: Speak your symptoms in native dialect. Get instant disease probability, risk level, and remedies.
suite_medicine_desc: Snap photo of pills or packaging. Gemini Vision extracts dosages and openFDA checks interactions.
suite_skin_desc: Upload skin rash or injury images for visual condition classification and essential first-aid steps.
suite_emergency_desc: One-tap emergency broadcast, geolocation extraction, and automated lookup of 5 nearest hospitals.
symptom_subtitle: Describe how you feel in your natural spoken language or type your symptoms below.
symptom_placeholder: e.g., I have a high fever, severe headache, and body aches for 2 days...
medicine_scanner_subtitle: Upload or snap a photo of any medicine strip or prescription to get instant dosages, warnings, and usage guidelines.
skin_subtitle: Upload a clear photo of skin rash, cut, or wound for AI risk estimation and immediate care steps.
emergency_subtitle: Instantly broadcast your GPS location to emergency services, contacts, and find nearest hospitals.
teleconsult_subtitle: Connect to certified physicians with real-time AI live language translation & consultation transcript.
records_subtitle: Offline PWA cached health reports, AI triage history, and official prescriptions.
dash_subtitle: All your health vitals, AI triage logs, and medication schedules in one place.
